segments.name: Campus Operations
segments.description: Runs all continuing campuses, offering diploma, certificate and associate degree programs in skilled trades, automotive, health sciences and information technology to students.
segments.evidence: Campus Operations - The Campus Operations segment includes campuses that are continuing in operation and contribute to the Company's core operations and performance.

segments.name: Transitional
segments.description: Held campuses marked for closure, taught out or held for sale; no campuses were classified here at year end.
segments.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company had no campuses classified as Transitional.

revenueModel.text: Students pay tuition and fees for the programs offered, largely funded through government-sponsored student financial aid programs.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues consist primarily of student tuition and fees derived from the programs we offer.

changes.text: The Summerlin, Las Vegas campus, reported in the Transitional segment, was sold in 2025.
changes.evidence: The sale of the Summerlin campus was consummated effective January 1, 2025.

changes.text: The Somerville, Massachusetts campus was closed in 2023 and classified in the Transitional segment.
changes.evidence: In addition, the Company closed the Somerville, Massachusetts campus in 2023.
